title: TNT Group broadens its expertise to expand into new markets
summary: Recently acquired by PM Studio Group, TNT Group is set to take its development in the luxury packaging market a step further. A specialist in high-value-added primary and secondary packaging, the company, founded in 2013, is focusing on diversifying its offering, expanding internationally and advancing eco-design. Recently appointed CEO, Damon Kennish will lead this new phase of growth. “Our strength lies in our ability to combine technical expertise with agility to meet the specific needs... - Packaging & design
